rv.q: This revival feels strangely dated and harmless, despite energetic performances from the cast.
The first Broadway revival of the 1960 musical ought to be a lot more fun.
This revival of the 1960 musical feels more like a high school production that has been given a professional budget than a Broadway show that deserves one.
Under the circumstances, this may be wise.
Alas, Broadway's new "Birdie" doesn't take flight.

After seeing the show, most audience members will likely leave with considerable satisfaction about the new theater, but will feel ambivalent, if not downright disappointed by, about this surprisingly mediocre and ultimately miscast production.
In the process, many of the charms have been smothered and characters emerge as plastic as the scenery.
